schema_hash_rules.ecma: SHA-256 of exact uncompressed XSD member bytes in the named nested ZIP.
schema_hash_rules.extensions: SHA-256 of the sole HTML pre block containing xsd:schema, decoded by Python HTMLParser, replacing U+00A0 with U+0020, then UTF-8 encoding. No trimming or newline changes. page_sha256 hashes response bytes.
schema_hash_rules.revision_boundary: PDF revisions and online schema snapshots are separately pinned. A page date is not a protocol revision; hashes do not assert schema compilation or identical PDF/HTML serialization.
